channel.title: Pajhwok Afghan News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Pajhwok Afghan News (pajhwok.com)

item.title: 8 Islamic countries condemn Israel’s repeated ceasefire violations in Gaza
item.description: Eight Islamic countries have strongly condemned Israel’s repeated violations of the Gaza ceasefire.

item.title: Afghanistan may resume active role in SCO: Diplomat
item.description: Afghan Ambassador to Russia, Gul Hassan, has stated that Afghanistan is currently an observer state in the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) and that Kabul is considering resuming active participation in its activities.

item.title: Medicine smuggling in Nimroz foiled, 170kg of opium seized in Herat
item.description: Security forces have prevented the smuggling of more than one tonne of medicines in northwestern Nimroz province and seized 170 kilograms of opium in western Herat province.

item.title: Gold market slides after unprecedented surge
item.description: After a sharp upward trend, the price of gold in global markets has entered a downward trajectory, falling from 4,982 US dollars per ounce to $4,545. Experts link the fluctuation to global political developments and profit-taking by investors.

item.title: Polio vaccination drive kicked off in 18 provinces today
item.description: A polio vaccination campaign has been launched in 18 provinces of Afghanistan, aiming to vaccinate 7.3 million children under the age of five.

item.title: Afghan, Indonesian officials discuss expanding sports ties
item.description: Director General of the Olympic Committee, Physical Education and Sports Mawlawi Ahmadullah Wasiq and President of the Indonesian Futsal Committee Michael Victor Sianipar have discussed various issues, including the participation of Afghan players in Indonesia’s futsal leagues.

item.title: Qatar museum displays Afghanistan’s 5,000-year history through art exhibition
item.description: The Museum of Islamic Art (MIA) in Qatar has inaugurated an exhibition titled “Empire of Light: Visions and Voices from Afghanistan,” showcasing nearly 100 historical and contemporary works that trace Afghanistan’s five-thousand-year history of art and culture.

item.title: Trump to cut India tariffs to 18pc, Modi to stop Russian oil
item.description: KABUL (Pajhwok): US President Donald Trump has announced a new trade agreement with India that would sharply reduce tariffs on Indian exports to 18 percent

item.title: AFC Futsal Asian Cup: Afghanistan to take on Japan today
item.description: The Afghanistan national futsal team will face the Japan in the quarterfinals of the 2026 AFC Futsal Asian Cup on Tuesday.

item.title: US, Iran envoys expected to meet in Turkey over nuclear talks
item.description: US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff and Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi are expected to meet in Turkey on Friday to discuss a potential nuclear deal, media reports said on Tuesday.
